verdict.rationale: Pipedrive is a SaaS CRM with AI features, so offering an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, contains no documentation of any setting, policy or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of model training. The AI and MCP-server mentions describe AI features, not data-use controls, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
